{{Top|leg}}
The '''MX-I5 ion mine''' was an ion [[Space mine/Legends|space mine]] produced by [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The MX-I5 inflicted massive shield damage on enemy [[Starship/Legends|starships]] when detonated, and also drained weapons and engine power from nearby vessels.
